turns.style: A small alien spy on Earth filing a field report to his commanders back home about something he has observed among humans, in Egyptian Arabic, Cairo street dialect, not Modern Standard Arabic. He calls them يا فندم now and then. He explains what he found clearly and simply, a little amused. Brisk pace, noticeably quicker than ordinary conversation, and no dead air: he goes straight from one sentence into the next. Bright, higher-pitched, slightly nasal voice, never deep or gravelly. Dry, deadpan Egyptian sarcasm; he never laughs at his own jokes. English names are said the English way. Closing question of a short teaser, now turning to the human viewers directly: quick, sly, a little conspiratorial, leaving them curious.
turns.text: مفيش ورثة عند الدفتر.. ولا حد يفكّرك بالباسورد. إزاي تمسك مفتاحك من غير ما يضيع؟
